description: Add navigation infrastructure, exercise library with 8 supported exercises, and workout session UI screens. This establishes the screen flow: HomeScreen -> ExerciseListScreen -> WorkoutSessionScreen -> WorkoutSummaryScreen.
steps: Create screens/ExerciseListScreen.js - A list of the 8 supported AI-tracked exercises (squats, push-ups, lunges, bicep curls, plank hold, shoulder press, jumping jacks, deadlifts). Each exercise card shows name, target muscles, difficulty, and an 'AI Tracked' badge. Tapping an exercise navigates to the workout session. Follow the card styling pattern from HomeScreen.js.

Create screens/WorkoutSessionScreen.js - The camera + pose detection screen. For now, create the layout structure: full-screen camera preview area (placeholder), overlay UI showing current exercise name, rep counter (large centered number), set counter, timer, and control buttons (start/pause/finish set). Include a skeleton overlay canvas area. Style with semi-transparent overlays on the camera feed.

Create screens/WorkoutSummaryScreen.js - Post-workout summary showing: exercise name, number of sets completed, reps per set, total duration, and a 'Save Workout' button. Follow the card styling pattern from HomeScreen.js.

Refactor App.js to use a combined navigator: keep the bottom tabs but wrap in a native stack navigator. The stack contains: MainTabs (the existing bottom tab navigator), ExerciseList, WorkoutSession, and WorkoutSummary screens. The ExerciseList should be accessible from a new 'AI Workouts' button on the HomeScreen.

Update screens/HomeScreen.js to add a prominent 'AI-Powered Workouts' card/button above the Today's Workouts section that navigates to ExerciseListScreen. Use a camera icon and highlight it as a new feature.
acceptance_criteria: App.js has a stack navigator wrapping the tab navigator with routes for ExerciseList, WorkoutSession, and WorkoutSummary
ExerciseListScreen renders 8 exercises with name, description, and AI-tracked indicator
WorkoutSessionScreen has the camera placeholder layout with rep counter overlay UI
WorkoutSummaryScreen shows workout results with save button
HomeScreen has an AI Workouts navigation button
All new .js files pass node --check syntax validation
verification: Run 'export NODE_OPTIONS="" && node --check App.js && node --check screens/HomeScreen.js && node --check screens/ExerciseListScreen.js && node --check screens/WorkoutSessionScreen.js && node --check screens/WorkoutSummaryScreen.js' from /projects/sandbox/snack
